system.name: GRACE
system.one_liner: a loss-resilient real-time video system built on a neural video codec jointly trained under packet losses

components.name: Motion estimator
components.role: estimates motion vectors between current and reference frame

components.name: MV encoder
components.role: encodes motion vectors into a quantized tensor

components.name: MV decoder
components.role: decodes the MV tensor back into motion vectors, mirrored inside the encoder to match the true decoder

components.name: Motion compensation
components.role: applies motion vectors to the reference frame to produce a motion-compensated frame

components.name: Frame smoothing
components.role: increases similarity between the motion-compensated frame and the current frame before residual computation

components.name: Residual encoder
components.role: encodes the residual differences into a quantized coded-residual tensor

components.name: MV decoder
components.role: decodes the received coded MV tensor into motion vectors

components.name: Motion compensation
components.role: applies decoded motion vectors to the reference frame

components.name: Frame smoothing
components.role: smooths the motion-compensated frame on the decoder side

components.name: Residual decoder
components.role: decodes the coded residual tensor back into residuals

flows.what: decoded residual added to compensated frame

content.key_idea: GRACE's encoder and decoder mirror a traditional video codec's motion-estimation/residual-coding pipeline, but every stage is a jointly-trained neural network, and the resulting quantized coded MV and residual tensors are the only data sent from encoder to decoder.
content.reading_order: left to right: current/reference frames enter the Grace Encoder pipeline, produce a coded tensor in the middle, which flows into the mirrored Grace Decoder pipeline to reconstruct the decoded frame.

summary: GRACE is a loss-resilient real-time video system whose neural video codec (NVC) jointly trains encoder and decoder under packet losses. Figure 3 shows the codec's workflow as two mirrored pipelines, Grace Encoder on the left and Grace Decoder on the right, connected by a small coded-tensor icon in the middle. The encoder chain runs Motion estimator, MV encoder, MV decoder, Motion compensation and Frame smoothing to compute a residual, which a Residual encoder turns into a quantized tensor; the decoder chain mirrors this with MV decoder, Motion compensation, Frame smoothing and Residual decoder to reconstruct the decoded frame. A legend marks orange boxes as NN modules and blue boxes as non-NN modules, and red dashed arrows trace the coded MV and coded residual tensors as they cross from encoder to decoder. The dense, two-column layout closely follows the structure of a traditional video codec while foregrounding which parts are now learned.
